## Moje mišljenje: BlueLite mora da pređe sa istraživanja pojedinačnih komponenti na proizvodnju univerzalnog sistema

Smatram da je primedba o vremenu potpuno opravdana. U našem radu smo prikupili izuzetno mnogo tehničkih dokaza, ali **broj završenih analiza nije isto što i broj gotovih, višekratno upotrebljivih proizvodnih pravila**\.

R135–R142 su dobar primer: dokazali smo mnogo o `Language.Basic`, ali nakon više eksperimenata još nemamo produkciono rešenje za taj target. Takvo istraživanje ima svoje mesto, ali ne sme neograničeno da odlaže izradu BlueLite-a.

Predlažem promenu prioriteta, ne odustajanje od cilja maksimalnog debloat-a.

### 1\. Nisam zanemario naš Sources katalog

Ponovo sam otvorio aktuelne GitHub fajlove [BlueLite\_Sources.md](https://github.com/johnny-belgrade/windows/blob/main/BlueLite_Sources.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com) i [Master Strategy v5.0.0](https://github.com/johnny-belgrade/windows/blob/main/BlueLite-Master_Germanium_Strategy_final.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com)\.

Za UUP fazu posebno su relevantni `abbodi1406/BatUtil`, `uup-converter-wimlib`, UUP Dump, Microsoft DISM dokumentacija, W10UI i MSMG Toolkit. Za poređenje rezultata i metodologije imamo i ostale reference iz kataloga, uključujući Atlas i zajednice za custom Windows buildove.

Proverio sam i dostupnost Library materijala i pročitao jedan konkretan `Timeline.txt`\. Nisam još izvršio sistematsko poređenje svih Timeline fajlova, istorijskih skripti ili Build Info dokumenata — upravo to je istraživanje za koje prvo tražiš zajedničku odluku.

### 2\. Već vidimo gde se krije najveći potencijal

U pregledanom Timeline fajlu pojavljuju se sledeći značajni UUP ulazi\:

| Paket ili grupa | Zabeležena veličina | Moja preliminarna procena |
|--------|--------|--------|
| `Windows11.0-KB5120998-x64.msu` | 4,3 GiB | Velik transportni/update paket, ne automatski kandidat za izbacivanje |
| `Microsoft-Windows-Client-Desktop-Required-Package.ESD` | 777 MiB | Rekonstrukciona osnova |
| `professional_en-us.esd` | 528 MiB | Edition/language osnova |
| `Microsoft-Windows-Client-Features-Package.ESD` | 250 MiB | Rekonstrukciona osnova |
| FoD referentni paketi | Veličine još nisu upoređene | Veliki potencijal za uslovni post-reconstruction debloat |
| Store/AppX paketi | Različite veličine | Najpogodniji za rano selektivno filtriranje |

To je važna razlika: **najveći paket tokom UUP preuzimanja nije nužno i najveća uklonjiva komponenta finalnog Windows-a**\.

Timeline pokazuje i brojne FoD porodice — WebView, Sense, LA57, dodatne jezičke funkcije, pojedine drajvere, Hyper-V i druge optional komponente. Ne znači da su sve instalirane u finalni WIM, niti da se sve mogu bezuslovno ukloniti.

Upravo zato treba odvojeno posmatrati veličinu preuzetog paketa, njegovu ulogu u sklapanju WIM-a, stvarni instalirani payload i fizički dobitak uklanjanja.

### 3\. Univerzalnost treba da bude na nivou pravila, ne imena fajlova

Predlažem sledeću klasifikaciju za svaki ozbiljan kandidat.

| Kategorija | Značenje | Postupak |
|--------|--------|--------|
| `PRE_DOWNLOAD_SELECT` | Podržano izostavljanje kroz converter/source konfiguraciju | Filtriranje pre preuzimanja |
| `RECONSTRUCTION_REQUIRED` | Potrebno za sklapanje Windows slike | Sačuvati do završetka rekonstrukcije |
| `POST_RECONSTRUCTION_REMOVE` | Može da se ukloni iz rekonstruisanog WIM-a | Automatski BlueLite MAX\_PRE |
| `CONDITIONAL_REMOVE` | Uklanjanje zavisi od edition-a, komponenti i korisničkog profila | Automatski dependency gate |
| `PROTECTED_KEEP` | Potrebna komponenta ili servisna zavisnost | Zadržati |
| `ENGINE_HANDOFF` | Nema potvrđene primenljive native metode | Predati sledećem komponentnom engine-u, tek uz odgovarajući dokaz |

Ovakva matrica može da važi za 26200, 26300 i naredne potvrđene Germanium buildove, bez posebne proizvodne skripte za svaki build.

Posebno je bitna jedna stvar koju je naša istorija već dokazala: preuranjeno izbacivanje Windows/FoD/reference paketa može prekinuti UUP delta rekonstrukciju. Zato maksimalni pre-debloat treba izvoditi i **nakon rekonstrukcije, ali pre pravljenja ISO-a**\. To je i aktuelna politika Master v5.0.0.

### 4\. Umesto novih desetina eksperimenata — jedan UUP MAX\_PRE engine

Predlažem da iskoristimo postojeće `.cmd`, `.ini`, `.ps1`, `CustomAppsList`, Timeline i dokazano uspešne BlueLite module da napravimo jedan proizvodni sistem.

**Izabrani Germanium UUP izvor**

26200 / 26300 / potvrđena naredna linija

**Univerzalni source/converter adapter**

Detekcija builda, paketa i reconstruction zavisnosti

**UUP download + ispravna WIM rekonstrukcija**

Bez destruktivnog uklanjanja potrebnih referenci

**BlueLite MAX\_PRE engine**

Zajedničke remove/keep politike i potvrđeni offline recepti

**Smanjeni WIM + ISO + izveštaj**

SHA, veličine, primenjena pravila i preostali dependency targeti

Ovo bi bila stvarna prva univerzalna faza BlueLite-a. Kasnija samostalna PowerShell faza koristila bi istu Component Intelligence bazu i ista pravila, umesto da ponavlja ono što je MAX\_PRE već završio.

### 5\. Kako bih organizovao istraživanje koje predlažeš

Ne bih počinjao novim eksperimentima na WIM-u. Prvo bih sistematski uporedio postojeće dokaze.

Konkretno, uporedio bih više Timeline fajlova za 26200 i 26300, izvukao paketne porodice i veličine, proverio odgovarajuće converter skripte i konfiguracije, a zatim za svaku veću porodicu razdvojio pitanje rekonstrukcione neophodnosti od mogućnosti uklanjanja nakon rekonstrukcije.

Build Info drugih autora koristio bih za poređenje **finalnog end-state-a**\: šta oni izbacuju, šta zadržavaju i koje nam potencijalno velike mete nedostaju. Njihovi dokumenti mogu potvrditi rezultate, ali ne i nepoznatu internu metodu kojom su do njih došli.

Rezultat tog istraživanja ne bi bio još jedan dug narativni izveštaj. Treba da dobijemo konkretne artefakte: rangiranu matricu velikih uklonjivih paketa, zajednički profil, reusable engine kod, listu već potvrđenih pravila i kratku cross-build regresionu proceduru.

Najvažnije: **prioritet kandidatima treba da određuje stvarni očekivani fizički dobitak, zajedno sa zavisnostima i mogućnošću automatizacije**, a ne samo koliko je teško ukloniti komponentu.

### 6\. Šta radimo sa R7 i ostalim otvorenim istraživanjima?

Predlažem da R7 trenutno parkiramo kao `RED_HOLD`, sa svim sačuvanim dokazima, i da ne otvaramo naredni eksperiment dok ne ocenimo prioritet kroz novu matricu. To nije `KEEP_SKIP`, niti predaja NTLite-u.

R142 je u međuvremenu uspešno završen: pronađena su tri približna TextPredictionEngine registry kandidata, ali ne i potvrđen component owner. Hive je uredno oslobođen, mountova nema, a R113/R133 hash vrednosti su očuvane.

Taj checkpoint i tvoju odluku o pauzi upisao sam u [GitHub Current Status](https://github.com/johnny-belgrade/windows/commit/5532f5a55a904015c8310a31a7c9ec5f54162dca?utm_source=chatgpt.com)\. Nijedna naredna R7 komanda nije pokrenuta niti predložena za izvršavanje.

**Edge i WebView — dve odvojene velike mete**

Zvanični converter podržava `SkipEdge=1` za neintegrisanje `Edge.wim` na odgovarajućim Windows 11 buildovima. To ne potvrđuje automatski da je bezbedno izbaciti Edge.wim iz originalnog download queue-a. \[[BatUtil/uup-converter-wimlib/ReadMe.html at master · abbodi1406/BatUtil](https://github.com/abbodi1406/BatUtil/blob/master/uup-converter-wimlib/ReadMe.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)\]

WebView FoD (\~194 MiB preuzetog CAB-a) ima zaseban BlueLite native `Remove-Capability` precedent. Na novom buildu proverava se prisutnost i prethodno sertifikovana topologija.

**Speech, TextToSpeech, Handwriting, Hello Face**

Ove porodice daju bolji odnos očekivane koristi i složenosti od novog istraživanja sitnih CBS wrapper-a. Native FoD uklanjanje je dokumentovan mehanizam, ali svaki target prolazi test stanja i zavisnosti. \[[Available features on demand](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/manufacture/desktop/features-on-demand-non-language-fod?view=windows-11&utm_source=chatgpt.com)\]\[[DISM Capabilities Package Servicing Command-Line Options](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/manufacture/desktop/dism-capabilities-package-servicing-command-line-options?view=windows-11&utm_source=chatgpt.com)\]

`Language.Basic` na 26200.9711 nije deo te automatske grupe dok važi potvrđeno CBS odbijanje `0x800F0825`\.

---

**Cleanup, WinSxS i kompresija**

U postojećoj konfiguraciji već imamo `Cleanup=1`, `ResetBase=1`, `SkipWinRE=1` i završni WIM export. To ne znači da dodatni ResetBase u našoj PowerShell skripti automatski daje drugu veliku uštedu.

Pošto ResetBase menja mogućnost uklanjanja već integrisanih ažuriranja, njegov stvarni efekat i CU servicing moraju se meriti, ne pretpostavljati. \[[Clean Up the WinSxS Folder](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/manufacture/desktop/clean-up-the-winsxs-folder?view=windows-11&utm_source=chatgpt.com)\]\[[BatUtil/uup-converter-wimlib/ReadMe.html at master · abbodi1406/BatUtil](https://github.com/abbodi1406/BatUtil/blob/master/uup-converter-wimlib/ReadMe.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)\]

## Inventar `C:\work` - read-only

Skripta će napraviti jedan ZIP u standardnom direktorijumu `C:\work\scripts`\. Sadržaće kompletan spisak fajlova, veličine svih direktorijuma, najveće fajlove, grupisanje po ekstenzijama, moguće duplikate po nazivu i veličini, nedostupne putanje i trenutno evidentirane WIM mountove.

**Neće montirati WIM, kopirati velike fajlove, računati njihove hash vrednosti niti brisati postojeće podatke.** Automatski uklanja samo sopstvene privremene CSV izveštaje nakon uspešnog ZIP pakovanja. Duplikati ostaju samo kandidati dok ih zasebno ne potvrdimo.

**Jedina komanda - PowerShell 7 Admin\:**

```powershell
& {
    Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false

    $Root = 'C:\work'
    $OutDir = 'C:\work\scripts'

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Root -PathType Container)) {
        throw "ROOT_NOT_FOUND=$Root"
    }

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $OutDir -PathType Container)) {
        throw "SCRIPTS_DIRECTORY_NOT_FOUND=$OutDir"
    }

    $Root = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Root).TrimEnd('\')

    $Stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    $Unique = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8)
    $Base = "BlueLite_CWork_Inventory_${Stamp}_${Unique}"

    $Stage = Join-Path $OutDir ".$Base.stage"
    $Zip = Join-Path $OutDir "$Base.zip"

    if (
        (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Stage) -or
        (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Zip)
    ) {
        throw 'INVENTORY_OUTPUT_COLLISION'
    }

    function Quote-Csv {
        param([string]$Value)
        return '"' + $Value.Replace('"', '""') + '"'
    }

    function Get-DirectoryRecord {
        param([string]$Path)

        if (-not $Stats.ContainsKey($Path)) {
            $Stats[$Path] = [pscustomobject]@{
                Path           = $Path
                DirectBytes    = [long]0
                RecursiveBytes = [long]0
                DirectFiles    = [long]0
                RecursiveFiles = [long]0
                DirectFolders  = [long]0
            }
        }

        return $Stats[$Path]
    }

    $Stats = [System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary[string,object]]::new(
        [StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
    )

    $Extensions = [System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary[string,object]]::new(
        [StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
    )

    $LargeFiles = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
    $Pending = [System.Collections.Generic.Stack[string]]::new()

    $LargeThreshold = [long](64MB)

    $FileCount = [long]0
    $DirectoryCount = [long]0
    $TotalBytes = [long]0
    $ErrorCount = [long]0
    $ReparseCount = [long]0

    [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($Stage) | Out-Null

    $Encoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)

    $ManifestPath = Join-Path $Stage '01_All_Files.csv'
    $ErrorPath = Join-Path $Stage '07_Access_Errors.csv'
    $ReparsePath = Join-Path $Stage '08_Reparse_Points.csv'

    $ManifestWriter = [IO.StreamWriter]::new(
        $ManifestPath, $false, $Encoding
    )

    $ErrorWriter = [IO.StreamWriter]::new(
        $ErrorPath, $false, $Encoding
    )

    $ReparseWriter = [IO.StreamWriter]::new(
        $ReparsePath, $false, $Encoding
    )

    $ManifestWriter.WriteLine(
        'RelativePath,FileName,Extension,Bytes,LastWriteUTC'
    )

    $ErrorWriter.WriteLine('Path,Error')
    $ReparseWriter.WriteLine('Path,Type')

    $Pending.Push($Root)
    $null = Get-DirectoryRecord $Root

    Write-Host '===================================================='
    Write-Host 'BLUELITE - C:\WORK READ-ONLY INVENTORY'
    Write-Host '===================================================='
    Write-Host "ROOT=$Root"
    Write-Host "OUTPUT_ZIP=$Zip"
    Write-Host 'MODE=METADATA_ONLY'
    Write-Host 'WIM_MOUNT=NO'
    Write-Host 'FILE_HASH_SCAN=NO'
    Write-Host 'EXISTING_DATA_DELETE=NO'
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'Scanning filesystem metadata...'

    try {
        while ($Pending.Count -gt 0) {
            $Current = $Pending.Pop()
            $DirectoryCount++

            try {
                foreach (
                    $Entry in
                    [IO.Directory]::EnumerateFileSystemEntries($Current)
                ) {
                    if ($Entry -ieq $Stage -or $Entry -ieq $Zip) {
                        continue
                    }

                    try {
                        $Attributes = [IO.File]::GetAttributes($Entry)

                        $IsDirectory = (
                            ($Attributes -band
                            [IO.FileAttributes]::Directory) -ne 0
                        )

                        $IsReparse = (
                            ($Attributes -band
                            [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0
                        )

                        if ($IsReparse) {
                            $ReparseCount++

                            $Kind = if ($IsDirectory) {
                                'DIRECTORY_REPARSE_SKIPPED'
                            }
                            else {
                                'FILE_REPARSE_SKIPPED'
                            }

                            $ReparseWriter.WriteLine(
                                "$(Quote-Csv $Entry),$(Quote-Csv $Kind)"
                            )

                            continue
                        }

                        if ($IsDirectory) {
                            $null = Get-DirectoryRecord $Entry

                            $Stats[$Current].DirectFolders++
                            $Pending.Push($Entry)
                            continue
                        }

                        $Info = [IO.FileInfo]::new($Entry)
                        $Bytes = [long]$Info.Length

                        $Relative = $Entry.Substring($Root.Length + 1)
                        $Extension = $Info.Extension.ToLowerInvariant()

                        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Extension)) {
                            $Extension = '[none]'
                        }

                        $Modified = $Info.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('o')

                        $ManifestWriter.WriteLine(
                            "$(Quote-Csv $Relative),$(Quote-Csv $Info.Name),$(Quote-Csv $Extension),$Bytes,$(Quote-Csv $Modified)"
                        )

                        $FileCount++
                        $TotalBytes += $Bytes

                        $Stats[$Current].DirectBytes += $Bytes
                        $Stats[$Current].DirectFiles++

                        $Ancestor = $Current

                        while ($true) {
                            $Stats[$Ancestor].RecursiveBytes += $Bytes
                            $Stats[$Ancestor].RecursiveFiles++

                            if ($Ancestor -ieq $Root) {
                                break
                            }

                            $Ancestor = [IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName(
                                $Ancestor
                            )

                            if (-not $Stats.ContainsKey($Ancestor)) {
                                throw "UNEXPECTED_PARENT=$Ancestor"
                            }
                        }

                        if (-not $Extensions.ContainsKey($Extension)) {
                            $Extensions[$Extension] = [pscustomobject]@{
                                Extension = $Extension
                                FileCount = [long]0
                                Bytes     = [long]0
                            }
                        }

                        $Extensions[$Extension].FileCount++
                        $Extensions[$Extension].Bytes += $Bytes

                        if ($Bytes -ge $LargeThreshold) {
                            $LargeFiles.Add(
                                [pscustomobject]@{
                                    RelativePath = $Relative
                                    FileName = $Info.Name
                                    Extension = $Extension
                                    Bytes = $Bytes
                                    LastWriteUTC = $Modified
                                    DuplicateKey = (
                                        "$Bytes|$($Info.Name.ToLowerInvariant())"
                                    )
                                }
                            )
                        }

                        if (($FileCount % 10000) -eq 0) {
                            Write-Host (
                                "FILES=$FileCount; " +
                                "LOGICAL_GiB=$([math]::Round($TotalBytes / 1GB, 2))"
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    catch {
                        $ErrorCount++

                        $ErrorWriter.WriteLine(
                            "$(Quote-Csv $Entry),$(Quote-Csv $_.Exception.Message)"
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            catch {
                $ErrorCount++

                $ErrorWriter.WriteLine(
                    "$(Quote-Csv $Current),$(Quote-Csv $_.Exception.Message)"
                )
            }
        }
    }
    finally {
        $ManifestWriter.Dispose()
        $ErrorWriter.Dispose()
        $ReparseWriter.Dispose()
    }

    Write-Host 'Metadata scan completed. Building reports...'

    $AllDirectories = @(
        $Stats.Values |
            Sort-Object RecursiveBytes -Descending
    )

    $AllDirectories |
        Select-Object `
            @{N='RelativeDirectory';E={
                if ($_.Path -ieq $Root) {
                    '.'
                }
                else {
                    $_.Path.Substring($Root.Length + 1)
                }
            }},
            DirectBytes,
            RecursiveBytes,
            DirectFiles,
            RecursiveFiles,
            DirectFolders |
        Export-Csv `
            -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Stage '02_Directory_Totals.csv') `
            -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8

    $TopLevel = @(
        $AllDirectories |
            Where-Object {
                [IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($_.Path) -ieq $Root
            } |
            Sort-Object RecursiveBytes -Descending
    )

    $TopLevel |
        Select-Object `
            Path,
            DirectBytes,
            RecursiveBytes,
            DirectFiles,
            RecursiveFiles,
            DirectFolders |
        Export-Csv `
            -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Stage '03_Top_Level_Directories.csv') `
            -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8

    $SortedLarge = @(
        $LargeFiles | Sort-Object Bytes -Descending
    )

    $SortedLarge |
        Select-Object `
            RelativePath,
            FileName,
            Extension,
            Bytes,
            LastWriteUTC |
        Export-Csv `
            -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Stage '04_Large_Files_64MiB_Plus.csv') `
            -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8

    @($Extensions.Values | Sort-Object Bytes -Descending) |
        Export-Csv `
            -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Stage '05_Extension_Totals.csv') `
            -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8

    $DuplicateGroups = @(
        $SortedLarge |
            Group-Object DuplicateKey |
            Where-Object Count -gt 1
    )

    $DuplicateReport = @(
        foreach ($Group in $DuplicateGroups) {
            foreach ($Item in $Group.Group) {
                [pscustomobject]@{
                    GroupKey = $Group.Name
                    GroupCount = $Group.Count
                    PotentialDuplicateBytes = (
                        [long]$Item.Bytes * ($Group.Count - 1)
                    )
                    RelativePath = $Item.RelativePath
                    Bytes = $Item.Bytes
                }
            }
        }
    )

    $DuplicateReport |
        Sort-Object PotentialDuplicateBytes -Descending |
        Export-Csv `
            -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Stage '06_Possible_Duplicates_METADATA_ONLY.csv') `
            -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8

    $PriorityExtensions = @(
        '.wim', '.esd', '.iso', '.vhd', '.vhdx',
        '.msu', '.cab', '.zip', '.7z', '.rar'
    )

    $PriorityFiles = @(
        $SortedLarge |
            Where-Object {
                $_.Extension -in $PriorityExtensions
            }
    )

    $PriorityFiles |
        Select-Object RelativePath, FileName, Extension, Bytes, LastWriteUTC |
        Export-Csv `
            -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Stage '09_Large_Artifact_Review.csv') `
            -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8

    $MountOutput = @(
        & dism.exe /English /Get-MountedWimInfo 2>&1 |
            ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }
    )

    $MountExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    @(
        "DISM_EXIT_CODE=$MountExitCode"
        $MountOutput
    ) | Set-Content `
        -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Stage '10_DISM_Mount_State.txt') `
        -Encoding utf8

    $HiveAliases = @(
        [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::LocalMachine.GetSubKeyNames() |
            Where-Object {
                $_ -match '^(BL\d|BlueLite|FB\d|FBConan)'
            } |
            Sort-Object
    )

    @(
        'READ_ONLY_HKLM_ALIAS_NAME_CENSUS'
        'NOTE=Alias names alone do not establish registry handle ownership.'
        "MATCH_COUNT=$($HiveAliases.Count)"
        $HiveAliases
    ) | Set-Content `
        -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Stage '11_HKLM_Project_Aliases.txt') `
        -Encoding utf8

    $Disk = [IO.DriveInfo]::new('C')

    $Summary = @(
        '============================================================'
        'BLUELITE C WORK - READ-ONLY STORAGE INVENTORY'
        '============================================================'
        "ROOT=$Root"
        "GENERATED=$(Get-Date -Format o)"
        'MODE=METADATA_ONLY'
        'EXISTING_FILES_MODIFIED=NO'
        'WIM_COPIES_CREATED=0'
        'WIM_MOUNTS_CREATED=0'
        'EXISTING_FILES_DELETED=0'
        'LARGE_FILE_HASHING=NOT_PERFORMED'
        ''
        "DIRECTORIES_VISITED=$DirectoryCount"
        "DIRECTORIES_RECORDED=$($Stats.Count)"
        "FILES=$FileCount"
        "LOGICAL_BYTES=$TotalBytes"
        "LOGICAL_GiB=$([math]::Round($TotalBytes / 1GB, 3))"
        "FILES_64MiB_PLUS=$($LargeFiles.Count)"
        "POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_GROUPS=$($DuplicateGroups.Count)"
        "REPARSE_POINTS_SKIPPED=$ReparseCount"
        "ACCESS_ERRORS=$ErrorCount"
        "DISM_MOUNT_QUERY_EXIT_CODE=$MountExitCode"
        "PROJECT_REGISTRY_ALIASES=$($HiveAliases.Count)"
        ''
        "C_DRIVE_TOTAL_GiB=$([math]::Round($Disk.TotalSize / 1GB, 3))"
        "C_DRIVE_AVAILABLE_GiB=$([math]::Round($Disk.AvailableFreeSpace / 1GB, 3))"
        ''
        'IMPORTANT:'
        '1. Logical file sizes are NOT NTFS unique allocated bytes.'
        '2. Hardlinks, sparse files, compression and WIM internal resources may change physical disk accounting.'
        '3. Same name and length are NOT proof of identical file content.'
        '4. No file or directory is approved for deletion by this report.'
        '5. Report staging was excluded from the scan.'
        '6. Directory sizes are recursive; do not sum parent and child rows.'
        ''
        'SCAN_STATUS=' + $(if ($ErrorCount -eq 0) {
            'COMPLETE_NO_ACCESS_ERRORS'
        }
        else {
            'PARTIAL_REVIEW_ACCESS_ERRORS'
        })
        ''
        '=== TOP 30 DIRECTORIES BY RECURSIVE LOGICAL SIZE ==='
    )

    $Rank = 0

    foreach ($Dir in ($AllDirectories | Select-Object -First 30)) {
        $Rank++

        $Summary += (
            "$Rank | " +
            "$([math]::Round($Dir.RecursiveBytes / 1GB, 3)) GiB | " +
            "$($Dir.RecursiveFiles) files | " +
            "$($Dir.Path)"
        )
    }

    $Summary += ''
    $Summary += '=== TOP 30 FILES ==='

    $Rank = 0

    foreach ($Item in ($SortedLarge | Select-Object -First 30)) {
        $Rank++

        $Summary += (
            "$Rank | " +
            "$([math]::Round($Item.Bytes / 1GB, 3)) GiB | " +
            "$($Item.RelativePath)"
        )
    }

    $Summary += ''
    $Summary += '=== FINAL CONTRACT ==='
    $Summary += 'READ_ONLY_INVENTORY=PASS'
    $Summary += 'DELETION_AUTHORIZED=NO'
    $Summary += 'NEXT=REVIEW_ZIP_AND_CLASSIFY_RECLAIM_CANDIDATES'

        -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Stage '00_SUMMARY.txt') `
        -Encoding utf8

    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.ZipFile

    [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::CreateFromDirectory(
        $Stage,
        $Zip,
        [IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal,
        $false
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Zip -PathType Leaf)) {
        throw "INVENTORY_ZIP_MISSING=$Zip"
    }

    $ZipInfo = Get-Item -LiteralPath $Zip

    if ($ZipInfo.Length -eq 0) {
        throw "INVENTORY_ZIP_EMPTY=$Zip"
    }

    $ZipSHA = (
        Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Zip -Algorithm SHA256
    ).Hash

    # Delete only the uniquely created report staging directory.
    # No existing C:\work content is removed.
    [IO.Directory]::Delete($Stage, $true)

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '===================================================='
    Write-Host 'BLUELITE INVENTORY COMPLETED'
    Write-Host '===================================================='

    Write-Host "FILES=$FileCount"
    Write-Host "DIRECTORIES=$DirectoryCount"
    Write-Host "LOGICAL_GiB=$([math]::Round($TotalBytes / 1GB, 3))"
    Write-Host "LARGE_FILES=$($LargeFiles.Count)"
    Write-Host "DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE_GROUPS=$($DuplicateGroups.Count)"
    Write-Host "ACCESS_ERRORS=$ErrorCount"
    Write-Host "REPARSE_POINTS_SKIPPED=$ReparseCount"

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host "OUTPUT_ZIP=$Zip"
    Write-Host "ZIP_BYTES=$($ZipInfo.Length)"
    Write-Host "ZIP_SHA256=$ZipSHA"
    Write-Host 'EXISTING_DATA_DELETED=NO'
    Write-Host 'INVENTORY=PASS_READONLY'
}
```

            Group = 'R36_26200_9550'
            Text = 'BlueLite_R36_Converter_26200.9550_cb4d2d02'

        $null

            Where-Object {
                $_.Extension.ToLowerInvariant() -in $TextExtensions -and
                $_.Length -le 2MB -and
                -not $_.FullName.StartsWith(

                    [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
                ) -and
                -not $_.FullName.StartsWith(

                    [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
                ) -and

                    [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
                ) -and

                )

                            Group = $Token.Group
                            File = $File.FullName
                            Token = $Token.Text
                            Classification = 'REFERENCE_REQUIRES_REVIEW'
                        }
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        catch {
            Add-A01Issue 'CONSUMER_SCAN' (

        }
    }

                Where-Object { $_.Group -eq $Pair.Group }
        ).Count -gt 0

        $Decision = if ($Pair.Result -ne 'PASS_CURRENT_SHA_EQUAL') {

        }

            CandidatePath = $R132
            ProtectedSourcePath = $R113
            Bytes = $R132Bytes
            SHA256 = $R132CurrentSHA
            Decision = $R132Decision
            DeletionAuthorized = 'NO'
        }
    )

    $Pairs |
        Export-Csv -LiteralPath (
            Join-Path $Stage '01_Current_SHA256_Pairs.csv'
        ) -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8

    $Candidates |

            Join-Path $Stage '02_Exact_Candidate_Paths.csv'
        ) -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8

    $Retained |
        Export-Csv -LiteralPath (
            Join-Path $Stage '03_Explicitly_Retained_Content.csv'
        ) -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8

    $References |
        Export-Csv -LiteralPath (
            Join-Path $Stage '04_Consumer_References.csv'
        ) -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8

    $Issues |
        Export-Csv -LiteralPath (
            Join-Path $Stage '05_Issues.csv'
        ) -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8

    $PassedPairs = @(
        $Pairs |
            Where-Object Result -eq 'PASS_CURRENT_SHA_EQUAL'
    )

    $ReviewCandidates = @(
        $Candidates |
            Where-Object {
                $_.Decision -eq
                'CONTENT_DUPLICATE_OPERATOR_REVIEW_REQUIRED'
            }
    )

    $ReviewBytes = [long]0

    foreach ($Item in $ReviewCandidates) {

    }

    $Summary = @(
        '============================================================'
        'BLUELITE STORAGE A01 - PRE-DELETE EVIDENCE'
        '============================================================'
        "GENERATED=$(Get-Date -Format o)"
        'MODE=READ_ONLY_SHA_AND_CONSUMER_AUDIT'
        'EXISTING_FILES_DELETED=0'
        'WIM_MOUNTS_CREATED=0'
        'WIM_COPIES_CREATED=0'
        'HIVE_LOADS_CREATED=0'
        'DISM_INITIAL_MOUNTS=0'
        'INITIAL_PROJECT_HKLM_ALIASES=0'
        ''
        "R100_HISTORICAL_PAIR_ROWS=$($Rows9711.Count + $Rows9550.Count)"
        "CURRENT_PAIRS_CHECKED=$($Pairs.Count)"
        "CURRENT_SHA_PASS_PAIRS=$($PassedPairs.Count)"
        "CURRENT_SHA_HOLD_PAIRS=$($Pairs.Count - $PassedPairs.Count)"
        ''
        "R132_BYTES=$R132Bytes"
        "R113_EXPECTED_SHA256=$R113SHA"
        "R113_CURRENT_SHA256=$R113CurrentSHA"
        "R132_CURRENT_SHA256=$R132CurrentSHA"
        "R132_RESULT=$R132Result"
        ''
        "RETAINED_NONPAIR_FILES=$($Retained.Count)"
        "CONSUMER_REFERENCES=$($References.Count)"
        "ISSUES=$($Issues.Count)"
        ''
        "CONTENT_VERIFIED_REVIEW_CANDIDATES=$($ReviewCandidates.Count)"
        "CONTENT_VERIFIED_REVIEW_LOGICAL_BYTES=$ReviewBytes"
        "CONTENT_VERIFIED_REVIEW_LOGICAL_GiB=$([math]::Round($ReviewBytes / 1GB, 3))"
        ''
        'IMPORTANT:'
        'PASS_CURRENT_SHA_EQUAL means current stage and source match pinned historical SHA256.'
        'R132 requires exact equality with the pinned R113 SHA256.'
        'Consumer text hits are review leads, not confirmed active dependencies.'

        'Logical bytes are NOT guaranteed NTFS physical reclaim.'
        'No deletion is authorized, even if every candidate passes.'

        'RESULT=EVIDENCE_COLLECTED_OPERATOR_REVIEW_REQUIRED'
        'DELETION_AUTHORIZED=NO'
    )

    $Summary | Set-Content -LiteralPath (
        Join-Path $Stage '00_SUMMARY.txt'
    ) -Encoding utf8

    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.ZipFile

    [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::CreateFromDirectory(
        $Stage,
        $Zip,
        [IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal,

    )

    if (
        -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Zip -PathType Leaf) -or

    ) {

    }

        Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Zip -Algorithm SHA256
    ).Hash

    # Removes ONLY the uniquely created small report staging directory.
    [IO.Directory]::Delete($Stage, $true)

    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '============================================================'
    Write-Host 'BLUELITE STORAGE A01 - COMPLETE'
    Write-Host '============================================================'
    Write-Host "CURRENT_SHA_PASS_PAIRS=$($PassedPairs.Count)/227"
    Write-Host "R132_RESULT=$R132Result"
    Write-Host "CONSUMER_REFERENCES=$($References.Count)"
    Write-Host "ISSUES=$($Issues.Count)"
    Write-Host "REVIEW_LOGICAL_GiB=$([math]::Round($ReviewBytes / 1GB, 3))"
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host "OUTPUT_ZIP=$Zip"
    Write-Host "ZIP_SHA256=$ZipSHA"

        Write-Output 'INITIAL_MOUNTS_AND_HIVES=ZERO_PASS'

        $ActualInventorySHA = (
            Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Inventory -Algorithm SHA256
        ).Hash

        if ($ActualInventorySHA -cne $InventorySHA) {
            throw 'ORIGINAL_INVENTORY_SHA256_MISMATCH'
        }

        Write-Output 'ORIGINAL_INVENTORY_SHA256=PASS'

        Assert-PlainPath $KeepWim

        $KeepInfo = Get-Item -LiteralPath $KeepWim

        if ($KeepInfo.Length -ne $KeepWimBytes) {
            throw 'REFERENCE_WIM_LENGTH_CHANGED'
        }

        Write-Output 'HASHING_PROTECTED_R133_REFERENCE'

        $ActualKeepSHA = (
            Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $KeepWim -Algorithm SHA256
        ).Hash

        if ($ActualKeepSHA -cne $KeepWimSHA) {
            throw 'REFERENCE_WIM_SHA256_MISMATCH'
        }

        Write-Output 'REFERENCE_R133_SHA256=PASS'

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $AlreadyDeleted) {
            throw 'PREVIOUSLY_DELETED_R132_HAS_REAPPEARED'
        }

        Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression

        $Archive = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($Inventory)

        try {
            $Entry = $Archive.GetEntry(
                '04_Large_Files_64MiB_Plus.csv'
            )

            if ($null -eq $Entry) {
                throw 'INVENTORY_LARGE_FILES_CSV_MISSING'
            }

            $Reader = [IO.StreamReader]::new($Entry.Open())

            try {
                $Content = $Reader.ReadToEnd()
            }
            finally {
                $Reader.Dispose()
            }
        }
        finally {
            $Archive.Dispose()
        }

        $InventoryRows = @(
            $Content -split '\r?\n' |
                Where-Object { $_ -ne '' } |
                ConvertFrom-Csv
        )

        if ($InventoryRows.Count -ne 69) {
            throw "ORIGINAL_INVENTORY_COUNT_CHANGED=$($InventoryRows.Count)"
        }

        $Candidates = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()

        $Seen = [System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new(
            [StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
        )

        foreach ($Row in $InventoryRows) {
            $Relative = [string]$Row.RelativePath

            if (
                [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Relative) -or
                [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($Relative) -or
                $Relative.Contains('/') -or
                $Relative -match '(^|\\)\.\.?($|\\)'
            ) {
                throw "UNSAFE_INVENTORY_RELATIVE_PATH=$Relative"
            }

            $Size = [long]$Row.Bytes
            $Extension = ([string]$Row.Extension).ToLowerInvariant()

            if ($Size -lt $MinimumBytes) {
                continue
            }

            if ($Extension -notin $AllowedExtensions) {
                continue
            }

            $AllowedRoot = (
                $Relative.StartsWith(
                    'E2E\',
                    [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
                ) -or
                $Relative.StartsWith(
                    'G5\',
                    [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
                ) -or
                $Relative.StartsWith(
                    'backup\',
                    [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
                )
            )

            if (-not $AllowedRoot) {
                continue
            }

            $FullPath = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath(
                (Join-Path $Root $Relative)
            )

            if (
                [IO.Path]::GetExtension($FullPath).ToLowerInvariant() -ne
                $Extension
            ) {
                throw "EXTENSION_CONTRACT_MISMATCH=$FullPath"
            }

            if (
                $FullPath -ieq $KeepWim -or
                $FullPath -ieq $AlreadyDeleted
            ) {
                continue
            }

            if (-not $Seen.Add($FullPath)) {
                throw "DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE_PATH=$FullPath"
            }

            $Candidates.Add(
                [pscustomobject]@{
                    RelativePath = $Relative
                    Path = $FullPath
                    Bytes = $Size
                    LastWriteUTC = [string]$Row.LastWriteUTC
                }
            )
        }

        $TotalBytes = [long]0

        foreach ($Item in $Candidates) {
            $TotalBytes += [long]$Item.Bytes
        }

        if (
            $Candidates.Count -ne $ExpectedCount -or
            $TotalBytes -ne $ExpectedBytes
        ) {
            throw (
                "CANDIDATE_SET_DRIFT_COUNT=$($Candidates.Count);" +
                "BYTES=$TotalBytes"
            )
        }

        Write-Output "CANDIDATE_COUNT=$($Candidates.Count)"
        Write-Output "CANDIDATE_LOGICAL_BYTES=$TotalBytes"
        Write-Output "CANDIDATE_LOGICAL_GiB=$([math]::Round($TotalBytes / 1GB, 3))"

        Write-Output ''
        Write-Output 'VERIFYING_ALL_54_FILES_BEFORE_ANY_DELETION'

        foreach ($Item in $Candidates) {
            Assert-CurrentFileMatchesInventory $Item
        }

        Write-Output 'ALL_54_FILE_METADATA_GATES=PASS'

        $Sorted = @(
            $Candidates | Sort-Object Bytes -Descending
        )

        $Sorted |
            Select-Object RelativePath, Path, Bytes, LastWriteUTC |
            Export-Csv -LiteralPath $PlanCsv `
                -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8

        Assert-NoMountsOrProjectHives

        Write-Output 'FINAL_PREDELETE_MOUNT_AND_HIVE_GATE=PASS'
        Write-Output 'STARTING_EXACT_FILE_DELETION'
        Write-Output ''

        $FreeBefore = [IO.DriveInfo]::new('C').AvailableFreeSpace

        Write-Output "C_FREE_BYTES_BEFORE=$FreeBefore"

        foreach ($Item in $Sorted) {
            try {
                Assert-CurrentFileMatchesInventory $Item

                if (
                    -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $KeepWim -PathType Leaf) -or
                    (Get-Item -LiteralPath $KeepWim).Length -ne
                    $KeepWimBytes
                ) {
                    throw 'PROTECTED_R133_CHANGED_DURING_CLEANUP'
                }

                Write-Output "DELETE_EXACT=$($Item.Path)"

                [IO.File]::Delete($Item.Path)

                if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Item.Path) {
                    throw 'FILE_STILL_PRESENT_AFTER_DELETE'
                }

                $DeletedCount++
                $DeletedBytes += [long]$Item.Bytes

                [pscustomobject]@{
                    Path = $Item.Path
                    Bytes = $Item.Bytes
                    Result = 'DELETED_AND_ABSENT'
                    TimeUTC = [datetime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
                } |
                    Export-Csv -LiteralPath $ExecutionCsv `
                        -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8 -Append

                Write-Output "DELETED_OK=$DeletedCount/$ExpectedCount"
            }
            catch {
                [pscustomobject]@{
                    Path = $Item.Path
                    Bytes = $Item.Bytes
                    Result = "FAILED: $($_.Exception.Message)"
                    TimeUTC = [datetime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
                } |
                    Export-Csv -LiteralPath $ExecutionCsv `
                        -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8 -Append

                throw
            }
        }

        Assert-PlainPath $KeepWim
        Assert-NoMountsOrProjectHives

        $FinalKeepSHA = (
            Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $KeepWim -Algorithm SHA256
        ).Hash

        if ($FinalKeepSHA -cne $KeepWimSHA) {
            throw 'PROTECTED_R133_FINAL_SHA256_MISMATCH'
        }

        $FreeAfter = [IO.DriveInfo]::new('C').AvailableFreeSpace
        $FreeDelta = [long]($FreeAfter - $FreeBefore)

        Write-Output ''
        Write-Output '============================================================'
        Write-Output 'BLUELITE STORAGE A03 - FINAL RESULT'
        Write-Output '============================================================'

        Write-Output "DELETED_FILES=$DeletedCount"
        Write-Output "DELETED_LOGICAL_BYTES=$DeletedBytes"
        Write-Output "DELETED_LOGICAL_GiB=$([math]::Round($DeletedBytes / 1GB, 3))"

        Write-Output "C_FREE_BYTES_BEFORE=$FreeBefore"
        Write-Output "C_FREE_BYTES_AFTER=$FreeAfter"
        Write-Output "C_FREE_DELTA_BYTES=$FreeDelta"
        Write-Output "C_FREE_DELTA_GiB=$([math]::Round($FreeDelta / 1GB, 3))"

        Write-Output 'PROTECTED_R133_SHA256=PASS'
        Write-Output 'FINAL_MOUNTS_AND_HIVES=ZERO_PASS'
        Write-Output 'SMALL_FILES_AND_LOGS_PRESERVED=BY_SCOPE'
        Write-Output 'DIRECTORIES_DELETED=0'
        Write-Output '26300_UUP_DOWNLOAD_STARTED=NO'
        Write-Output 'A03=PASS_EXACT_54_LARGE_FILES_REMOVED'

        Write-Output ''
        Write-Output "REPORT=$Report"
        Write-Output "PLAN_CSV=$PlanCsv"
        Write-Output "EXECUTION_CSV=$ExecutionCsv"
    }
    catch {
        Write-Output ''
        Write-Output "A03_FAIL_CLOSED=$($_.Exception.Message)"
        Write-Output "FILES_ALREADY_DELETED=$DeletedCount"
        Write-Output "DELETED_LOGICAL_BYTES=$DeletedBytes"
        throw
    }
    finally {
        if ($TranscriptStarted) {
            Stop-Transcript | Out-Null
        }
    }
}
```

**Pošalji TXT izveštaj i `Execution.csv` iz `C:\work\logs`**\. Pošto je ovo trajno brisanje, skripta ne može automatski vratiti već obrisane fajlove ako dođe do prekida; zato pre prve operacije proverava ceo skup, a svaki izvršeni korak zasebno beleži.

Nakon potvrđenog `A03=PASS` prelazimo direktno na **prvi test custom UUP download-a Windows 11 26H2 / 26300.9711**, sa našim već dokazanim velikim pre-debloat zahvatima.

**Slažem se sa prethodnim kolegom. Za BlueLite 26H2 / 26300.9711 preporučujem da .NET Framework 3.5 NE integrišemo tokom UUP konverzije.**

Razlozi su konkretni\:

- **Manji početni Windows image** — ne dodajemo opcioni legacy .NET payload i njegove servisne komponente.
- **Čistiji pre-debloat** — manje paketnih i CBS zavisnosti koje treba obrađivati.
- **Jednostavniji WinSxS cleanup** — izbegavamo dodatni komponentni sadržaj pre završetka glavnog uklanjanja.
- **Naknadna instalacija** — zadržavamo je kao opciju za korisnike kojima je potrebna zbog starijih programa.

Važna tehnička razlika: **\.NET 3.5 sam po sebi ne ometa debloat.** Problem je što njegovom ranom integracijom proširujemo komponentni i servisni graf koji pokušavamo da maksimalno smanjimo.
